verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only on-request agent work. You can ask the agent to 'automate tasks like organizing a folder', it handles multi-step tasks 'in a single request', and it can spawn and track subagents. Nothing documents user-configured automations that run unattended in the background, such as schedules, triggers, or recurring jobs. Automatic file indexing is a built-in system behavior, and the scriptable CLI is a developer building block, so neither counts as a user-set-up background automation.
